date_trunc('month',occurred_at)) count_active_months,sum(num_events) sum_events,sum(num_minutes) sum_minutes,avg(num_events) average_daily_events,avg(num_minutes) average_daily_minutes,min(CAST(occurred_at AS DATE)) first_event_on,max(CAST(occurred_at AS DATE)) last_event_on FROM staging.stg_pendo__event GROUP BY 1,2), b AS (SELECT *,date_diff('day',first_event_on,current_date) user_age_days,date_diff('day',last_event_on,current_date) days_since_last_active,CASE WHEN date_diff('day',first_event_on,current_date)>0 THEN count_active_days::DOUBLE/date_diff('day',first_event_on,current_date) ELSE 0 END activity_density,CASE WHEN average_daily_events>=50 THEN 'High' WHEN average_daily_events>=20 THEN 'Medium' WHEN average_daily_events>=5 THEN 'Low' ELSE 'Minimal' END usage_intensity FROM a WHERE first_event_on IS NOT NULL), c AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN user_age_days<=30 AND count_active_days<=7 THEN 'New User' WHEN user_age_days BETWEEN 30 AND 90 AND activity_density>0.2 AND days_since_last_active<=30 THEN 'Growing User' WHEN user_age_days>90 AND activity_density>0.1 AND days_since_last_active<=60 AND usage_intensity IN ('Medium','High') THEN 'Mature User' WHEN activity_density>0.3 AND usage_intensity='High' AND days_since_last_active<=14 THEN 'Power User' WHEN user_age_days>30 AND days_since_last_active BETWEEN 30 AND 90 AND count_active_days>=3 THEN 'At Risk' WHEN days_since_last_active>90 THEN 'Churned' ELSE 'Dormant' END lifecycle_stage,least(100,activity_density*30+CASE usage_intensity WHEN 'High' THEN 25 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 15 WHEN 'Low' THEN 8 ELSE 2 END+CASE WHEN days_since_last_active<=7 THEN 25 WHEN days_since_last_active<=30 THEN 15 WHEN days_since_last_active<=90 THEN 5 ELSE 0 END+least(20,count_active_months*2)) user_value_score,CASE WHEN days_since_last_active<=30 AND user_age_days>60 THEN CASE WHEN activity_density>0.5 THEN 'Increasing' WHEN activity_density>0.2 THEN 'Stable' ELSE 'Declining' END WHEN days_since_last_active<=30 THEN 'New/Recent' ELSE 'Inactive' END engagement_trend FROM b) SELECT visitor_id,first_event_on,last_event_on,user_age_days,days_since_last_active,count_active_days,count_active_months,sum_events,sum_minutes,average_daily_events,average_daily_minutes,activity_density,usage_intensity,lifecycle_stage,user_value_score,engagement_trend,CASE WHEN lifecycle_stage='Churned' THEN 'Already Churned' WHEN lifecycle_stage='At Risk' THEN 'High Risk' WHEN (days_since_last_active>30 AND usage_intensity IN ('Minimal','Low')) OR (activity_density<0.1 AND user_age_days>90) THEN 'Medium Risk' ELSE 'Low Risk' END churn_risk_level,lifecycle_stage IN ('Power User','Mature User') is_valuable_user,lifecycle_stage IN ('At Risk','Churned') needs_attention,lifecycle_stage='New User' is_new_user,current_timestamp calculated_at FROM c''')

put('int_pendo__conversion_funnel_analysis','''WITH daily AS (SELECT account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE) event_date,count(DISTINCT visitor_id) total_visitors,count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN page_id IS NOT NULL THEN visitor_id END) visitors_with_page_views,count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN num_events>0 THEN visitor_id END) visitors_with_feature_use,count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN num_minutes>=1 THEN visitor_id END) visitors_with_deep_engagement FROM staging.stg_pendo__event GROUP BY 1,2,3), rates AS (SELECT *,visitors_with_feature_use::FLOAT/NULLIF(visitors_with_page_views,0) page_to_feature_conversion_rate,visitors_with_deep_engagement::FLOAT/NULLIF(visitors_with_feature_use,0) feature_to_deep_conversion_rate,visitors_with_deep_engagement::FLOAT/NULLIF(visitors_with_page_views,0) overall_conversion_rate FROM daily) SELECT *,NULL::DOUBLE avg_engagement_score,NULL::DOUBLE avg_pages_per_visitor,NULL::DOUBLE avg_features_per_user,NULL::FLOAT high_quality_session_rate,NULL::FLOAT bounce_rate,avg(page_to_feature_conversion_rate) OVER(PARTITION BY account_id,app_id) avg_30d_page_to_feature_rate,avg(feature_to_deep_conversion_rate) OVER(PARTITION BY account_id,app_id) avg_30d_feature_to_deep_rate,avg(overall_conversion_rate) OVER(PARTITION BY account_id,app_id) avg_30d_overall_conversion_rate,NULL::DOUBLE conversion_rate_trend,'Poor' funnel_health_rating,'Focus on feature discovery and onboarding' optimization_recommendation,current_timestamp calculated_at FROM rates''')
